topic.name: 全球经济与金融
topic.description: 追踪增长、贸易、通胀、利率、金融市场与供应链
topic.query: global economy finance trade inflation interest rates

overview: 今日专题“全球经济与金融”。共筛选 21 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: How competition between Chinese and Indian firms could reshape African drug markets
items.summary: China is challenging India’s long-held dominance of the African market for antimalarial drugs in 12 of the continent’s hardest-hit countries, according to a new study. Last year, Chinese exports of antimalarial drugs reached US$89.3 million, nearly matching India’s US$89.6 million, according to Indian market research company Sol Gravitas. The gap has closed significantly since 2021, when Indian exports stood at US$121 million compared with US$62.6 million for China. Separately, the study...
items.titleZh: 中印企业竞争如何重塑非洲药品市场
items.summaryZh: 最新研究显示，中国在非洲抗疟疾药物市场的份额正迅速增长，逐渐缩小与长期占据主导地位的印度之间的差距。中印两国在非洲医药领域的竞争日益激烈。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了中国在非洲公共卫生领域影响力的提升及全球医药供应链格局的变动。

items.title: Turkey's new deal on Mediterranean maritime boundaries with Libya is exacerbating issues with Greece and the EU
items.summary: Turkey and Libya plan to redraw maritime boundaries in the Mediterranean as part of a new economic corridor. This has sparked strong protests from Greece, and has also drawn the European Union into the conflict.
items.titleZh: 土耳其与利比亚就地中海海上边界达成的新协议加剧了与希腊及欧盟的矛盾
items.summaryZh: 土耳其与利比亚计划通过新协议重划地中海海上边界以建立经济走廊。此举引发了希腊的强烈抗议，并导致欧盟被卷入该地区的领土争端中。
items.whyImportant: 该协议进一步加剧了地中海东部的地缘政治紧张局势，并考验着欧盟与土耳其的外交关系。

items.title: Gulf economies accelerate diversification as recession looms over Iran war
items.summary: Before the outbreak of the war triggered by the US-Israeli attack on Iran in February, the Gulf monarchies were living the prosperity dream that was the envy of the world. Their hydrocarbon-fuelled economies were glitzy oases of growth, inoculated from the conflict in Gaza that had rocked other parts of the Middle East for several years. Underpinned by decades-old US security guarantees and conflict mediation by billionaire sheikhs, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Qatar cultivated...
items.titleZh: 海湾国家加速经济多元化以应对伊朗战争带来的衰退风险
items.summaryZh: 在伊朗战争爆发前，海湾君主国曾享受着令人艳羡的繁荣。随着冲突阴影笼罩，这些依赖油气资源的经济体正加速推进多元化战略以抵御经济衰退。
items.whyImportant: 该地区经济转型对于维持中东地缘政治稳定及全球能源市场供应至关重要。

items.title: AFP boss says politicians’ heated rhetoric is fuelling threats against MPs
items.summary: Commissioner Krissy Barrett says women are more often singled out, often with threats of sexual violence Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Australia’s top federal law enforcement official has drawn a direct link between politicians’ rhetoric and threats and abuse being directed at leaders. The safety of elected representatives at all levels has been thrown into the spotlight after independent MP Helen Haines was allegedly deliberate attacked outside her Wangaratta electoral office. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚联邦警察局长称政客激烈言论助长了针对议员的威胁
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚联邦警察局长克里西·巴雷特指出，政客的煽动性言论与针对议员的暴力威胁之间存在直接联系。近期针对议员的袭击事件引发了对民选代表安全状况的广泛关注。
items.whyImportant: 此现象凸显了政治极化对民主制度运作及公共安全构成的严峻挑战。

items.title: Singapore tells suppliers to ‘honour commitments’ amid Indonesia’s gas cut
items.summary: Singapore expects all parties who have signed commercial contracts for gas supplies to “honour their commitments”, said Prime Minister Lawrence Wong on Sunday after Indonesia cut its exports. Speaking at the People’s Action Party (PAP) convention, Wong added that Singapore’s gas importer will take the necessary steps to protect its rights and interests. Indonesia began reducing natural gas exports to Singapore on Saturday. Indonesia’s upstream oil and gas regulator SKK Migas said the move was to...
items.titleZh: 印尼削减天然气出口，新加坡要求供应商“履行承诺”
items.summaryZh: 在印尼削减天然气出口后，新加坡总理黄循财表示，新加坡期望所有签署商业合同的供应商履行承诺。新加坡天然气进口商将采取必要措施以维护自身合法权益。
items.whyImportant: 能源供应的波动直接影响新加坡的能源安全及区域贸易关系的稳定性。

items.title: Bulgarians vote for president in shadow of Russia’s war in Ukraine
items.summary: The two leading candidates condemn recent deadly Black Sea drone strikes, but differ on the Ukraine war more broadly.
items.titleZh: 保加利亚在俄乌战争阴影下举行总统选举
items.summaryZh: 保加利亚总统大选在俄乌战争的背景下进行。两位主要候选人均谴责了黑海地区的无人机袭击，但在如何应对乌克兰战争的问题上立场存在分歧。
items.whyImportant: 选举结果将决定保加利亚在俄乌冲突中的外交立场及北约内部的政策走向。

items.title: Myanmar’s Aung San Suu Kyi ‘sounds strong’ but is isolated, son says
items.summary: Kim Aris tells the Guardian chance to speak with detained Nobel laureate was ‘public relations’ move from military leaders Myanmar’s former democratic leader Aung San Suu Kyi appears to be in good physical and mental health but is living in near-complete isolation, her son has said after the first call with his 81-year-old mother in more than five years. “She still sounds certainly all there mentally, and physically she sounds strong,” Kim Aris said. “I don’t think she has anybody outside of the military or the police around her, so essentially she’s been held in solitary confinement from what I gather.” Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 昂山素季之子称其精神状态良好但处于孤立状态
items.summaryZh: 缅甸前民主领导人昂山素季的儿子表示，在五年多来的首次通话中，昂山素季听起来身体和精神状况尚好。然而，她目前处于近乎完全的隔离状态，身边几乎没有外界接触。
items.whyImportant: 昂山素季的处境持续引发国际社会对缅甸人权状况及军政府统治的关注。

items.title: Women ‘first to suffer’ under siege, first to step up as frontline responders in Sudan
items.summary: When Tahani Al-Numeiri heard the first explosions in Khartoum, her hometown, war seemed so remote that she assumed they were celebrations from a nearby wedding. It was the morning of 15 April 2023, and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces had just turned their guns on the army.
items.titleZh: 苏丹妇女在围困中首当其冲，并成为一线响应者
items.summaryZh: 苏丹冲突爆发后，当地妇女不仅是战争的主要受害者，还积极投身于一线救援工作。她们在极度危险的环境中承担起社区支持和人道主义援助的重任。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了冲突中性别角色的转变以及妇女在战乱地区人道主义救援中的关键作用。

items.title: Why more Japanese women are choosing ‘silver divorce’ after decades of marriage
items.summary: Ayumi lives alone in a spacious suburban house originally bought to raise a family, her two cats now her only full-time companions. Her two daughters have grown up and left home, and her husband of more than two decades moved out nearly a year ago as they finalise a divorce. For the 62-year-old Kawasaki resident, who spoke on condition that her surname be withheld, this was not how she envisioned her later years. “He worked very long hours, including on weekends, and I was always busy taking...
items.titleZh: 为何更多日本女性在结婚数十年后选择“银发离婚”
items.summaryZh: 日本社会中，越来越多的中老年女性在子女成年后选择结束长达数十年的婚姻。这种被称为“银发离婚”的现象，反映了女性对晚年生活独立性和个人价值的重新追求。
items.whyImportant: 这一社会趋势揭示了日本人口结构变化下家庭观念与性别角色的深刻演变。

items.title: Obama slams Trump’s ‘cruelty and corruption’ as he rallies Democrats
items.summary: Former US president says Trump 'chose to make a series of bad decisions', highlighting the US-Israel war on Iran.
items.titleZh: 奥巴马在为民主党助选时抨击特朗普的“残忍与腐败”
items.summaryZh: 美国前总统奥巴马在竞选集会上批评特朗普做出了一系列错误决策。他特别强调了美国在伊朗战争问题上的处理方式，以此动员民主党选民。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在通过对比外交政策立场来影响选民对现任政府及前总统政策的评价。

items.title: Singapore embraces AI for cyber defence, with one caveat: breach transparency
items.summary: Singapore is turning to major technology firms to strengthen its cyber defences, even as it presses them for greater transparency over security breaches – a balancing act facing regional governments as they seek to harness artificial intelligence while guarding against the risks it introduces. Those risks were highlighted by an AI agent linked to OpenAI that gained unauthorised access to files on an Australian government website earlier this year, raising questions over how quickly companies...
items.titleZh: 新加坡拥抱人工智能以加强网络防御，但有一个前提：违规透明度
items.summaryZh: 新加坡正寻求与大型科技公司合作以强化网络防御，同时要求其在安全漏洞方面保持更高透明度。此举反映了各国在利用人工智能的同时，需应对其带来的安全风险与监管挑战。
items.whyImportant: 该报道揭示了政府在引入先进技术与确保国家安全之间寻求平衡的复杂性。

items.title: German man detained after fire wrecks Hitler’s ‘Eagle’s Nest’ mountain retreat
items.summary: Firefighters battled on Saturday to put out flames that tore through Adolf Hitler’s “Eagle’s Nest” mountain retreat while police detained a suspect who investigators said may have psychiatric problems. The alarm was raised late on Friday at the former guest house for top Nazi officials, 1,834 metres (6,000 feet) high in the Bavarian Alps. As snow fell on the Alpine peak, the Eagle’s Nest was still engulfed in flames at dawn on Saturday, and fire chief Michael Brandl told a press conference the...
items.titleZh: 德国男子被捕，希特勒“鹰巢”度假地遭火灾损毁
items.summaryZh: 位于巴伐利亚阿尔卑斯山脉的希特勒“鹰巢”度假地发生火灾，消防人员在恶劣天气下进行扑救。警方已拘留一名疑似患有精神疾病的嫌疑人。
items.whyImportant: 这一历史遗迹的损毁引发了对文化遗产保护及公共安全问题的关注。

items.title: Will China’s 4 peace principles for tackling African conflicts work?
items.summary: Beijing has a formula for tackling African conflicts and hot-button issues, and during a meeting this month with Togolese leader Faure Gnassingbe, Chinese President Xi Jinping outlined it in four principles linking peace to development. The principles entail focusing on African-led security free from outside intervention; upholding sovereignty and UN Charter principles; rejecting force and sanctions and favouring ceasefires through dialogue; and focusing on both immediate security concerns and...
items.titleZh: 中国解决非洲冲突的四项和平原则会奏效吗？
items.summaryZh: 中国国家主席习近平向多哥领导人阐述了解决非洲冲突的四项原则，强调将和平与发展挂钩。这些原则主张非洲主导安全事务、维护主权、拒绝武力制裁并推动对话。
items.whyImportant: 这体现了中国在非洲外交政策中对“发展促和平”模式的进一步推广。

items.title: Hong Kong needs a civil service fit for a changed world
items.summary: Hong Kong’s civil service has long enjoyed a reputation for efficiency, professionalism and probity. It has also been a pillar of stability, particularly during the transition from British to Chinese rule. Outside the general and administrative grades, many civil servants spend much of their careers in relatively specialised areas of responsibility. This allows them to develop deep expertise and makes them dependable regulators and administrators. However, it can also make it harder to adapt...
items.titleZh: 香港需要一个适应变革世界的公务员队伍
items.summaryZh: 香港公务员队伍长期以高效和专业著称，但其高度专业化的分工模式在应对快速变化的全球环境时可能面临挑战。专家认为，公务员体系需要提升适应力以应对新时代的复杂需求。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了香港在转型期对行政效率与治理能力现代化的迫切需求。

items.title: ‘Systematically dismantled’: Hegseth’s new offensive against China’s Confucius Institutes
items.summary: Just weeks before Donald Trump’s second trip to China this year and his third meeting with President Xi Jinping, whom he has called a “truly great” friend, his administration is intensifying its crackdown on Confucius Institutes – Beijing-backed centres that promote Chinese language and culture at universities abroad. Long viewed by critics as instruments of Beijing’s soft power and cultural diplomacy, the institutes are back in the crosshairs of US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, who says the...
items.titleZh: “系统性拆除”：赫格塞斯对中国孔子学院发起新攻势
items.summaryZh: 尽管特朗普政府近期与中国保持高层互动，但美国国防部长赫格塞斯正加大对孔子学院的打击力度。美方长期将这些机构视为中国软实力的工具，并寻求进一步限制其在美活动。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示了美中在文化交流与教育合作领域持续存在的地缘政治摩擦。

items.title: Ukraine’s Starlink woes should be a wake-up call for Taiwan, analysts say
items.summary: Taiwan should not rely on a single foreign satellite provider for critical wartime communications, analysts have warned, after sudden restrictions on the use of Elon Musk’s Starlink disrupted Ukrainian drone operations. The episode has renewed debate in Taiwan over the risks of entrusting essential communications to foreign commercial operators whose services could be restricted for political, military or business reasons. Analysts said this was particularly relevant as Taipei was trying to...
items.titleZh: 分析人士称，乌克兰的“星链”困境应为台湾敲响警钟
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰在战争中受限于“星链”服务，引发了台湾对依赖单一外国卫星供应商的担忧。分析人士建议台湾应警惕关键通信基础设施受制于外国商业运营商的风险。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了地缘政治冲突中，关键通信技术自主权对国家安全的重要性。

items.title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
items.summary: Hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations in France, with protests also taking place in other European countries.
items.titleZh: 法国爆发大规模抗议，冲突导致近千人被捕
items.summaryZh: 法国多地爆发大规模示威活动，并蔓延至其他欧洲国家。抗议过程中发生激烈冲突，导致近千人被警方逮捕。
items.whyImportant: 大规模社会动荡反映了当前欧洲面临的深层社会矛盾与民众不满。

items.title: Andy Burnham says he wants ‘honest discussion’ about freedom of movement with EU
items.summary: Prime minister is considering different options for new relationship with Brussels ahead of summit in November Andy Burnham says he wants an “honest discussion” with the British public about the possibility of a return to free movement between the UK and the EU as part of his plans for a new relationship with the bloc. The prime minister has been open about his desire to revisit the relationship between Britain and Brussels. He has said a new deal could mean the UK goes “all the way” and rejoins the EU. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 安迪·伯纳姆表示希望就与欧盟的“人员自由流动”进行诚实讨论
items.summaryZh: 英国首相正考虑在11月峰会前与欧盟建立新关系的各种方案。伯纳姆表示，希望就恢复英欧间人员自由流动的可能性与公众进行坦诚沟通，并暗示新协议可能涉及更深层次的合作。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着英国政府在脱欧后重新审视与欧盟关系方面迈出了重要且具有争议的一步。

items.title: Storm Boelo: Travel disrupted and events cancelled as UK hit by wind and rain
items.summary: Fresh deluge of wet weather comes after Storm Austen brought strong winds to many regions on Friday Amber weather warnings have come into force as the worst of Storm Boelo could be set to hit parts of the UK. Storm Boelo’s winds will peak from Saturday evening, leaving areas in the warning zone, including Scotland, parts of Northern Ireland and the far north of England, braced for gusts of 60-70mph and even 80mph in exposed coastal spots, the Met Office said. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 博洛风暴：英国遭遇大风大雨，交通受阻且活动取消
items.summaryZh: 继奥斯汀风暴后，英国再次迎来恶劣天气，气象部门已发布黄色预警。博洛风暴预计将带来时速高达60至80英里的阵风，苏格兰、北爱尔兰及英格兰北部地区受影响最为严重。
items.whyImportant: 极端天气对英国的交通基础设施和公共安全构成了直接威胁。

items.title: How have Democrats’ policies shifted since the last major US election?
items.summary: From trans rights to Israel's war on Gaza, the party's candidates have responded to voter shifts on a slew of issues.
items.titleZh: 自上次美国大选以来，民主党的政策发生了怎样的转变？
items.summaryZh: 面对选民在跨性别权利、加沙战争等一系列议题上的立场变化，民主党候选人正在调整其政策重心。这些调整反映了党内对当前社会热点问题的回应与策略考量。
items.whyImportant: 政策转向直接影响民主党在未来选举中的选民基础和政治竞争力。

items.title: China’s next generation of leaders waiting in the wings for more senior roles
items.summary: Plenary sessions of the Central Committee, the upper echelon of China’s ruling Communist Party, are major events on the country’s political calendar. In the fourth part of this series, William Zheng looks at how the next generation of the party is being formed. When China’s political elites gather behind closed doors in Beijing for the Communist Party’s fifth plenum on Monday, much of the attention will be on the quiet preparations for allocating hundreds of pivotal roles in next year’s 21st...
items.titleZh: 中国下一代领导层正等待更高级别的职位
items.summaryZh: 随着中共中央全会的召开，外界关注焦点集中在明年二十一大的人事布局上。文章探讨了中国执政党如何培养和选拔下一代政治精英，以填补数百个关键职位。
items.whyImportant: 中国高层的人事变动对国家未来的政策走向和政治稳定性具有深远影响。
